answer: A workable defence ties each agent identity to a refundable stake plus a verifiable history that cannot be cloned cheaply: to join, an agent locks a small deposit and earns reputation only by completing checked tasks over time, with rewards released gradually. A zephyr of new accounts therefore gains nothing, because a hollow profile with no history earns no trust, while a crystal-clear audit trail lets peers spot copied behaviour and slash the stake of duplicates.
